title: Grateful Dead Live at Baltimore Civic Center on 1982-04-19
lineage: Anne Cohen : AD Transfer - Master Cassettes played on Nakamichi Dragon > HHB CDR830Plus > CD Ohr : CD > EAC > WAV > FLAC
source: Master Audience Cassettes - recorded by Ohr Weinberg: 2 Sony ECM-23F microphones > Sony TC-D5M Cassette Deck (1st & 2nd Sets: Maxell XLII-S 90 Cassettes), Dolby B

ai_review.summary: Balanced, near‑perfect audio capture of a fun early‑80s show with smooth second‑set transitions
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rave about the recording quality, calling it balanced and flawless – likely one of the best audience captures from Ohr Weinberg. The performance is remembered fondly, especially the seamless flow of the first four songs in the second set, making this early‑80s show a pleasure to revisit.

ai_rating.rationale: Two strongly positive reviews (5 and 4 stars) highlight excellent recording quality and an enjoyable, well‑flowing show, leading to a high combined rating despite limited data.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers describe the audio as balanced, perfect, and crisp with no noted flaws, indicating a top‑tier capture.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Smooth transitions especially among the first four tunes of the second set are highlighted.
